description:
### ✨ New Features

* **Discord:** Add `Hide call button` patch, which removes Call from profiles so Message fills the row

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* **Discord - Message tap gestures:** Tapping your own message three times opens it for editing instead of deleting it
* **Discord - Venus settings:** Options on a setting's page stay switchable while that setting is off
* **Discord - NoDelete:** The maximum saved messages box can be edited while NoDelete is off

### 🔧 Improvements

* **Discord - Venus settings:** Clearer descriptions for every setting
* **Discord - NoDelete:** Say that it also keeps what edited messages said before
* **Discord - Pastelize:** Say that each color comes from the person's user ID
* **Discord - Message tap gestures:** Describe the Edit it and Reply to it choices

patches.name: CopyBios
patches.description: Lets you select and copy profile bios. Links still work.

patches.name: Custom voice messages
patches.description: Sends an audio file as a real voice message, with Discord's own waveform. Needs Android 10 or newer. Turn it on in Venus settings.

patches.name: Dashless
patches.description: Shows spaces instead of dashes in channel names. Only changes how they look.

patches.name: Disable advertising identifiers
patches.description: Stops Discord from reading your Google advertising ID. Always on once patched.

patches.name: Disable analytics
patches.description: Stops Discord's usage tracking and the analytics events it uploads. Always on once patched.

patches.name: Disable crash reporting
patches.description: Stops crash reports, screenshots and system logs from being sent to Sentry. Always on once patched.

patches.name: Disable install attribution
patches.description: Stops AppsFlyer from tracking how you installed the app. Some invite links that open before install may not work.

patches.name: Disable telemetry and touch logging
patches.description: Stops performance tracking and records of what you tap. Always on once patched.

patches.name: FavouriteAnything
patches.description: Lets you favourite any image or video from the media viewer.

patches.name: File size on picker
patches.description: Shows file sizes on photos and videos when you attach them.

patches.name: Force system emojis
patches.description: Shows your phone's emojis instead of Discord's, in chat, reactions and the emoji picker. Emojis your phone doesn't have stay Discord's.

patches.name: Force system font
patches.description: Lets Discord use your phone's font instead of gg sans. Turn it on in Venus settings. Needs Android 9 or newer.

patches.name: FreeNitro
patches.description: Sends emojis and stickers you can't use as image links. These are links, not real Nitro emojis or stickers.

patches.name: Hidden Channels
patches.description: Shows channels you can't open, with a lock and when they were created and last used. It can't show their messages. Turn it on in Venus settings.

patches.name: Hide Quests promotion
patches.description: Hides the Quests promotion above your profile bar, under the server list.

patches.name: Hide call button
patches.description: Removes the Call button from people's profiles. The Message button stretches across to fill the space.

patches.name: Hide gift button
patches.description: Removes the Nitro gift button from the message bar.

patches.name: JumpToTop
patches.description: Adds a button to jump to the first message in a chat, channel or thread.

patches.name: Message tap gestures
patches.description: Double-tap a message to reply, or to edit your own. Tap your own message three times to delete it. Based on Geastures+ by kmmiio99o. Turn it on in Venus settings.

patches.name: No typing
patches.description: Hides "typing..." from others when you type. You still see when they type.

patches.name: NoDelete
patches.description: Keeps deleted messages visible, outlined in red, and shows what edited messages said before. You can save both for good and choose how many to keep. Turn it on in Venus settings.

patches.name: Pastelize
patches.description: Gives names and mentions without a role color a soft pastel color, picked from each person's user ID so it never changes.

patches.name: PlatformIndicators
patches.description: Shows whether people are on desktop, mobile, web, console or VR, on profiles, in lists and in DMs.

patches.name: Quest Completer
patches.description: Completes video, Play and Activity Quests in the background when Discord is open, with no screen or tap. You still claim rewards yourself. Discord may pause Quests on accounts that do this.

patches.name: QuickDelete
patches.description: Skips the "are you sure?" when deleting messages or link previews. Turn it on in Venus settings.

patches.name: Read All
patches.description: Adds a Read all button to the server list, under the Direct Messages button. Choose whether it clears servers, DMs or both.

patches.name: ReviewDB
patches.description: Read and write reviews of users and servers, using the community ReviewDB service (manti.vendicated.dev). Turn it on in Venus settings.

patches.name: Venus settings
patches.description: Adds a Venus section to Discord's settings, where you can turn each plugin on or off. Needed by every plugin.
